West Bengal Declares Public Holiday for Syama Prasad Mookerjee's Anniversary

The West Bengal government has announced a public holiday on July 6 to commemorate the 125th birth anniversary of Syama Prasad Mookerjee. This declaration marks a significant recognition of Mookerjee's legacy by the state. The holiday will allow for widespread observance of the occasion across West Bengal.
